body: Ares Management ARES started a European logistics investment partnership with Norges Bank Investment Management, or NBIM, which has committed €1.5B ($1.7B) to the venture, the companies said Wednesday.Ares will participate in the partnership through its Ares Real Estate arm. The venture marks Ares' first collaboration with NBIM. In focusing on the robust demand for warehouses, Ares will provide expertise in logistics investments, while NBIM provides capital.The partnership will target attractive logistics investment opportunities across Europe, with a focus on modern, high-quality assets serving evolving supply chain, distribution, and e-commerce needs. The strategy will tap the insights and resources of Ares’ integrated logistics operating platform, Marq Logistics, which manages a portfolio of over 2,250 properties totalling more than 655M square feet."Demand for modern, well-located logistics facilities continues to be supported by powerful structural trends, and we believe we can capitalize on compelling opportunities through thoughtful asset selection and management," said Daan van den Hoven, partner and head of European Logistics at Ares ARES.Ares ARES stock rose 1.2% in premarket trading.DisclaimerContent provided by Seeking Alpha is intended for information purposes only, and that Seeking Alpha does not offer any personalist investment advice and is not a licensed securities dealer, broker, US investment adviser or investment bank.
